that share one soft light sweep, plus shimmering text for “Thinking…” states. $ pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/shimmer-loader.json Preview Code Copy prompt MCP Copy Generating summary… Reload When to use Placeholders while cards, lists or profiles load, shaped like the content that will arrive A shimmering status label while an AI answer or a long task is being generated When not to use Waits under ~300 ms – a flash of skeletons feels slower than showing nothing Progress you can measure; a progress bar tells the user how long is left Installation Add Shimmer Loader with the shadcn CLI – your project needs a components.json, see Installation in the docs – or copy the file by hand. Requires React 19. CLI Manual pnpm npm yarn bun Copy pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/shimmer-loader.json Usage example.tsx Copy import { Skeleton, ShimmerText } from "@/components/ui/shimmer-loader"; export function PostSkeleton() { return (
